title: Credit Desk Basis: Exposure, Limits and Holds on a Corporate Catering Service Agreement
content:
Credit exposure on a Corporate Catering Service Agreement is judged across everything the client has on the books, not on the single order being placed.

**What exposure is.** Exposure is the unsettled invoiced balance on the agreement plus the value of every order already accepted whose service day has not yet passed and which has neither been delivered nor cancelled.

**When an order is accepted.** An order is accepted while exposure after the order stays within the credit limit printed against the service level; an order that would carry exposure past the limit is held for the client to settle, part-pay or reduce.

**When open orders alone stop the account.** Where open orders alone reach the open-order multiple of the credit limit printed against the service level, the agreement is put on credit hold even though nothing is overdue, because the kitchen commitment alone is the risk. The number of unserved orders the agreement may carry at once is likewise printed against its service level.

**Which agreements may be held.** An agreement is only put on credit hold while it stands active or already on credit hold, and an agreement still in credit review is declined rather than held. The state the agreement stands in is read from the company's own agreement record, together with its unsettled balance and the limit printed against it, before the hold is worked.

**Agreements are never pooled.** Where a client holds more than one catering agreement, exposure is measured on each agreement separately and never pooled, since each carries its own limit.

**What a hold stops.** Once a hold is on, no order is accepted, no amendment that raises order value is accepted, and orders already in the kitchen for the next service day are served rather than cancelled.

| Agreement stands as | A credit hold may be worked | What happens instead |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Active | yes | — |
| On credit hold | yes | — |
| Pending credit review | no | the application is declined |
